name: ClamAV
description: ClamAV is an open-source antivirus engine for detecting trojans, viruses, malware and other threats. The clamd daemon serves scan requests over the network, so mail servers, Nextcloud, Paperless-ngx and other apps can use it as their virus scanner, while freshclam keeps the signatures up to date.

notes.text: clamd accepts unauthenticated connections on TCP port 3310. Only expose it to trusted networks.
To scan host storage, bind-mount it into the container and run `clamdscan --multiscan --fdpass /path`.
